[[Standard decade/Legends|Decades]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a corrupt '''admiral''' of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] sold off the remaining [[Starship/Legends|starships]] of the local [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] stationed at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].<ref name="Holonet" /> The [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]], who sold the ships to a number of wealthy [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], was never caught by Republic authorities, and the pirates would haunt shipping [[Hyperspace route/Legends|routes]] in the [[Bright Jewel sector/Legends|Bright Jewel sector]] for decades.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The admiral was first mentioned in the entry for Ord Mantell on [[the Holonet]], a division of the [https://www.swtor.com official site] for the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Holonet" />
